versions.changelog:
Initial release of mood-diary.

- Record daily moods in natural Chinese language, with automatic detection of 7 emotion types and 1–10 mood scoring.
- Intelligent tag extraction (people, things, places, weather) from diary entries.
- Generates daily, weekly, and monthly reports, plus trend analysis and a visual mood calendar.
- All data stored locally in JSON; zero network requests for maximal privacy.
- Includes command-line diary and report tools with configurable emotion keywords, emojis, and color codes.
